sentences.text:
This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.R.NIKHIL, NIMA MERIYAM KOSHY & HASNA JABIL, Advocates for the applicant, and STANDING COUNSEL(B/O)for R2, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2025  in  MACA.No.362 of 2025  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 06th day of February, 2025  ORDER
This is an application filed by the appellant praying for condoning the delay of 103 days in filing the appeal.

Manu V.M vs Nidheesh on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42384237/
1 2.
The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 103 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioner will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 2 nd respondent.
Policy is admitted, hence notice to the 1st respondent is dispensed with.
Post after two months for settlement.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 06-02-2025 /True Copy/
